display_long_description:
Crash the biggest House Mayhem party yet - together. Up to 8 players online, each as their own House Mayhem character, with a weapon in each hand.

PLAY ONLINE WITH FRIENDS
Quick Play finds a party in seconds, or start a Private Party and share a 4-digit code. Everyone sees the same guests and the same chaos. Optional voice chat; mute, block and report built in.

PICK YOUR CHARACTER
Ten characters - the clown, the jester, the bunny, the mouse, the biker and more. Others see you as them, with your real weapons in your hands.

THE BIGGEST HOUSE YET
Eight zones: the great lounge, upstairs, the basement club, backyard, garage, rooftop and a new Guest Wing with its own upstairs. Split up across floors or crash one room together.

A WEAPON WHEEL IN EACH HAND
Revolver, shotgun, rifle, sniper, bat, axe, hockey stick and knife. B for the right-hand wheel, Y for the left.

SHOOT EVERYTHING
Gas cans that explode, chandeliers that drop, pinatas, fish tanks, fireworks and balloons - it all breaks for everybody.

THE GUESTS FIGHT BACK
Brawlers charge, gunners fire rounds you can dodge. Heads, arms and legs come off. The bigger your crew, the bigger the next crowd.

Play solo offline any time.
